decided.singular: Single days where the daily max jumps to 85-117 while the daily mean stays low (days 1, 121, 135, 174, 239, 365), plus multi-day runs with mean far above neighbours (40-44 up to mean 56, 68-70 up to mean 65).

decided.lowest: Q3 has the longest stretches of low means (about 10-14) and the fewest elevated runs, though the margin over Q2 and Q4 is small, so this is low confidence.
decided.recurrence: Elevated days appear at irregular intervals with no steady 5-10 day spacing visible in the listing.
